Clips around one supply wire. Nothing is cut.

steps: Locked until a fob tap
Jonah's fob is not on Welder 2's trained list, so it stays locked. Amira is trained: it unlocks.
Power and gas on
The box closes the contactor and opens the gas valve. The session is logged to Amira.
Watches current and wire
The clamp reads the current every second and the scale weighs the spool. The first two weeks only learn the normal range.
Flags an irregular pattern
The owner gets one alert: Shut down, Call technician or Mark as OK.
Stops power and gas together
Nothing restarts on its own. Amira's session is logged with the wire she used.
Idle? Both off
If nobody welds for the idle time the owner sets, the box turns power and gas off.
Gas leak? Valve shuts
The sensor by the regulator is watched even with no session. The valve closes first, then the owner is told.

Who is on, and what the box is doing.
ESP32 with Wi-Fi and a current sensor.
Certified, 15 A at 120 V. Switches the printer.
Runs the box from the same outlet.
Wall mount, cord to the wall, outlet for the printer.
Load cell under the spool: grams per session.
USB cable: reads the job, can pause it.
steps: Locked until a fob tap
Amira's fob is not on this printer's trained list, so it stays locked. Priya is trained: it unlocks.
Power on
The box closes its relay and the printer turns on. The session is logged to Priya.
Heats up first: that's normal
A printer draws the most current while the bed and nozzle heat. PREVUMO knows this warm-up, so it raises no alert.
Prints and weighs filament
Once warm, the current settles into its normal range. The scale under the spool counts grams; the first two weeks only learn the normal range.
Failed print? Pause
Print time far past the estimate, or the spool stops losing weight: the box pauses the job and alerts the member.
Left heating? Power off
Heaters on and nothing moving for the time the owner sets, or a finished job still hot: the relay cuts power.

Pick print, laser or CNC after the tap.
Who is on, the mode, and what the box is doing.
ESP32 with Wi-Fi and a current sensor.
Certified, 15 A at 120 V. Switches the machine.
Runs the box from the same outlet.
Wall mount, cord to the wall, outlet for the machine.
Print mode: grams of filament per session.
Laser mode: no exhaust current, no laser.
steps: Locked until a fob tap
Jonah's fob is not on Multimaker 1's trained list, so it stays locked. Priya is trained: it unlocks.
Picks the mode
Priya presses CNC on the box. Each mode has its own trained list and its own normal range.
CNC: counts spindle minutes
The spin-up spike is normal for CNC, so no alert. The box logs the minutes the spindle runs.
Flags an irregular pattern
The current keeps climbing during the cut. The owner gets one alert and decides what happens.
Laser: exhaust first
Amira picks laser. The laser stays locked until the exhaust fan draws current, then laser-on minutes are logged.
Print: weighs filament
Lucas picks print. The scale under the spool counts the grams of his session.
Idle? Off
A finished job left switched on: the box turns it off after the idle time the owner sets.

parts: Members tap their fob; trained list per machine.
Who is on, and what the box is doing.
ESP32 with Wi-Fi; reads every sensor.
Opens the laser's enable line: no fob, no laser.
Runs the box from a wall outlet.
Wall mount and four cable glands.
Current clamp on the exhaust fan's cord.
Water temperature on the chiller's return hose.
On the air assist hose: no pressure, no job.
Looks at the bed from inside the laser.
steps: Locked until a fob tap
Priya's fob is not on Laser 1's trained list, so it stays locked. Lucas is trained: it unlocks.
Exhaust on first
The laser stays locked until the clamp sees the exhaust fan draw current.
Air assist, or no job
No pressure at the air switch blocks the job.
Cuts and logs minutes
Laser-on minutes go to Lucas's record. The coolant temperature is read the whole time.
Flame in the bed? Pause
The flame sensor pauses the laser first, then the owner is alerted.
Tapped out mid-job? Pause
A running laser is never left alone: tapping out pauses the job and alerts the owner.
Coolant too warm? Stop
The laser stops before the tube is damaged, then the owner is alerted.
Idle? Off
Nothing running for the owner's idle time: the enable line opens and the session ends.
